newsitem.title: USA: Intel EPS estimates raised by Robertson.
newsitem.headline: Intel EPS estimates raised by Robertson.

text.p: Robertson, Stephens & Co analyst Dan Niles said he raised his estimates of Intel Corp's earnings for 1996 and for 1997 and reiterated a buy as well as a $100 price target by the end of 1996.

Niles raised his share earnings estimates for 1996 to $4.65 from $4.50 previously, by raising his third and fourth quarter estimates by $0.05 and $0.10 respectively. His new third quarter estimate is $1.15, and fourth quarter is $1.30.
He raised his 1997 estimate to $5.75 from $5.50 a share.
Intel rose 1-3/16 to 81 on over 4.2 million shares traded.
